caption:
Allah's promise: remember Him and He remembers you

Allah says to remember Him and He will remember us, to be grateful to Him and not ungrateful. Give the first minutes of your morning to His remembrance.

Surah Al-Baqara 2:152

Make dhikr your first words today, before any scrolling

#dhikr #rememberallah #morningdhikr #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
